milestones.goal: J1 runs end to end: answer, talk (PTT + typed), caller answers with code-held facts and panic, scorecard
deployed, polished to the mockup, scenarios, judged path

tasks.title: Scaffold Next app, tokens route and live health probe
tasks.objective: Next 16 app with tokens/fonts; GET /api/tokens mints STT+TTS temporary tokens; GET /api/health makes one real TTS call
acceptance: WHEN /api/tokens is called THE SYSTEM SHALL return {stt, tts} tokens and never the key
verify: observe: curl /api/health returns tts ok and /api/tokens returns two tokens locally

tasks.title: Caller engine: scenario, intents, panic, disfluency, read-back, scoring
tasks.objective: Pure TS engine with vitest tests for the Cardiac arrest scenario

tasks.title: Voice layer: TTS and STT browser clients
tasks.objective: TTS WebSocket (Generate/Flush/Cancel, PCM playback, WordBoundaries on the playback clock) and STT WebSocket (mic worklet 16 kHz, PTT gating, ForceEndpoint)

tasks.title: Console golden path: ring, answer, talk, scorecard, typed path
tasks.objective: app/page.tsx wires engine + voice; ugly is fine
verify: observe: a full call in Chrome: answer, ask the address by voice, read it back, Location verified, scorecard

tasks.title: LLM fallback route with digit guard and timeout
tasks.objective: POST /api/caller-line via LLM Gateway, in character, digits replaced by code, 2.5 s timeout to a scripted line

tasks.title: First deploy to Vercel and live probe
tasks.objective: Production deploy, env var set, smoke + /api/health probe
verify: observe: the deployed URL opens signed out and /api/health returns tts ok
